product.title: Small-Group Half-Day Tour Foothills of the Rockies from Denver

description.text: First-time visitors to Denver appreciate this opportunity to escape the city for a few hours to see key attractions in the foothills. Let a professional do the driving on mountain byways, while you sit back and take in the sights. Stops include Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, Lariat Loop. You'll visit the iconic Red Rocks Amphitheatre, will stop by the Buffalo Bill Museum and Grave, will drive the Lariat Loop, and more. Ideal for visitors basing in Denver who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating transport, trailheads, or mountain logistics on their own.
